phase_prompt.summary: The altar as it appears in chapter 39, a fusion of ancient Ethiopian/Egyptian stonework and hidden advanced tech.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A towering altar of basalt and polished titanium, its stepped tiers carved with ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian hieroglyphs that pulse with bioluminescent light; crystalline conduits run beneath the stone, channeling unseen energy, while hidden filigree refracts ambient light into a subtle aurora, all rendered in photorealistic, tactile detail, grounded in industrial mysticism.
